item.text: {"search_note":"I found strong evidence that Marcos was closer to the economic and administrative parts of his program by end-2024. I did not find reliable evidence that he had achieved a durable ideological consolidation or a fully cleaned-up political environment. The remaining gap is mainly causality and durability: many positive macro indicators improved by year-end, but some of that likely reflected broader disinflation and external conditions, not only domestic policy.","evidence":[{"title":"IMF Article IV Consultation Press Release","publisher":"International Monetary Fund","date":"December 19, 2024","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/12/17/pr-24478-philippines-imf-concludes-2024-article-iv-consultation","summary":"The IMF said the Philippines handled external headwinds well, growth stayed resilient, inflation averaged 3.2% in 2024, and fiscal consolidation was underway. This is the strongest independent sign that Marcos ended the year closer to his stability-and-growth program than he began.","question_ids":["8B.10"]},{"title":"Philippine Statistics Authority 2024 Inflation Report","publisher":"Philippine Statistics Authority","date":"2024 annual report","url":"https://psa.gov.ph/price-indices/cpi-ir/node/1684065571","summary":"Annual inflation fell to 3.2% in 2024 from 6.0% in 2023, with food inflation also easing. That supports a real year-end improvement on one of Marcos’s core revealed priorities: inflation control.","question_ids":["8B.10"]},{"title":"SONA 2024 / Philippine Development Plan implementation frame","publisher":"Presidential Communications Office / NEDA","date":"July 23, 2024","url":"https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/sona-highlights-whole-of-government-effort-to-achieve-food-security-inclusive-economic-growth-neda/","summary":"Marcos explicitly tied the SONA to implementing the Philippine Development Plan 2023-2028 and to food security, inclusive growth, and coordinated whole-of-government delivery. This shows the program became more operationalized by midyear.","question_ids":["8B.10"]},{"title":"Pag-Abot Program institutionalization","publisher":"Presidential Communications Office via PIA","date":"January 22, 2024","url":"https://mirror.pia.gov.ph/press-releases/2024/01/22/pbbm-issues-eo-no-52-institutionalizing-and-expanding-dswds-pag-abot-program-for-street-dwellers-other-poor-and-vulnerable-individuals","summary":"EO 52 turned anti-poverty rhetoric into a standing inter-agency program with monitoring and reporting for street dwellers and other vulnerable groups. That is concrete evidence of institutionalized delivery rather than pure slogan politics.","question_ids":["8B.10"]},{"title":"New Government Procurement Act","publisher":"Presidential Communications Office","date":"July 20, 2024","url":"https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pbbm-signs-laws-on-streamlining-procurement-combatting-online-scams/","summary":"The procurement reform standardized forms, institutionalized e-procurement, and reduced discretion and favoritism. This supports a reading that Marcos moved the state closer to a cleaner, more rule-based governing model.","question_ids":["8B.10"]},{"title":"POGO ban and enforcement follow-through","publisher":"Presidential Communications Office","date":"November 11, 2024","url":"https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pbbm-refutes-alleged-loophole-in-eo-74-reiterates-pogo-ban-in-all-forms/","summary":"Marcos closed loophole arguments around the offshore-gaming ban after already ordering the sector wound down. This is strong evidence of a corrective anti-rent move that pushed the administration closer to its stated anti-crime, public-order agenda.","question_ids":["8B.10"]},{"title":"Flood-control response after Typhoon Carina and Habagat","publisher":"Presidential Communications Office","date":"July 26, 2024","url":"https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pbbm-calls-for-comprehensive-national-flood-control-plan-to-protect-communities-production-areas/","summary":"Marcos ordered a national flood-control plan and swift assistance after severe flooding, framing the response around protecting communities and production areas. This supports a modest year-over-year gain in crisis-management capacity and program execution.","question_ids":["8B.10","8B.9"]},{"title":"South China Sea incident-prevention agreement with Vietnam","publisher":"Presidential Communications Office","date":"January 30, 2024","url":"https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/ph-viet-nam-sign-agreements-on-rice-trade-agriculture-scs-incident-prevention-and-management/","summary":"Marcos secured a formal incident-prevention and management agreement plus coast-guard cooperation, which is evidence of preserving external stability through institutional channels rather than escalation.","question_ids":["8B.10","8B.9","2B.7"]},{"title":"Provisional arrangement and maritime communication channels with China","publisher":"Reuters / ThePrint","date":"July 21, 2024 and July 17, 2024","url":"https://www.theprint.in/world/china-philippines-agree-on-provisional-arrangement-for-south-china-sea-resupply-missions-manila-says/2184146/","summary":"Manila and Beijing created new maritime communication channels and then reached a provisional arrangement framed as de-escalation through dialogue and consultation. This is one of the clearest signs that Marcos improved immediate regional stability by year-end.","question_ids":["8B.10","8B.9","2B.7"]},{"title":"Provisional arrangement and maritime communication channels with China","publisher":"Reuters / ThePrint","date":"July 21, 2024 and July 17, 2024","url":"https://www.theprint.in/world/exclusive-philippines-china-to-set-up-three-new-channels-to-handle-south-china-sea-rows-source-and-document-say/2178053/","summary":"Manila and Beijing created new maritime communication channels and then reached a provisional arrangement framed as de-escalation through dialogue and consultation. This is one of the clearest signs that Marcos improved immediate regional stability by year-end.","question_ids":["8B.10","8B.9","2B.7"]},{"title":"Red-tagging and civic-space pressure persisted","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"September 25, 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/09/25/philippines-dangerous-red-tagging-labor-leaders","summary":"HRW reported ongoing harassment, threats, and red-tagging of union leaders and other groups. This is strong counterevidence: the regime’s broader political-control environment did not clearly move toward liberalization or durable institutional restraint.","question_ids":["8B.10","8B.9"]},{"title":"Freedom in the World 2024: Philippines","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/philippines/freedom-world/2024","summary":"Freedom House said elections were still distorted by disinformation, vote buying, patronage, and red-tagging. That means Marcos’s program advanced in state capacity terms, but not in a way that clearly cleaned up the broader political field.","question_ids":["8B.10","8B.9"]},{"title":"No PH cooperation with ICC unless PRRD wants it","publisher":"Presidential Communications Office","date":"November 14, 2024","url":"https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/no-ph-cooperation-with-icc-unless-prrd-wants-it-pbbm/","summary":"Marcos refused independent ICC cooperation on the Duterte drug war, allowing only tightly controlled domestic review. That is a clear limit on accountability and weakens any claim of broad institutional deepening.","question_ids":["8B.10","8B.9"]},{"title":"Rice tariff cut and later partial failure","publisher":"Philippine News Agency / GMA News Online","date":"June 12, 2024 and December 10, 2024","url":"https://www.pna.gov.ph/articles/1226754","summary":"The administration made a data-based tariff cut to stabilize rice prices, but NEDA later said retail pass-through was limited. This is the clearest mixed case: Marcos was adapting policy, but the flagship relief measure did not fully deliver.","question_ids":["8B.10"]},{"title":"Rice tariff cut and later partial failure","publisher":"Philippine News Agency / GMA News Online","date":"June 12, 2024 and December 10, 2024","url":"https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/money/economy/929579/neda-reduced-rice-tariffs-failed-to-lower-prices/story/","summary":"The administration made a data-based tariff cut to stabilize rice prices, but NEDA later said retail pass-through was limited. This is the clearest mixed case: Marcos was adapting policy, but the flagship relief measure did not fully deliver.","question_ids":["8B.10"]}]}
